m0-context-classify.title: Load context and classify the skill
m0-context-classify.imperative: Read inherited doctrine, project deltas, frozen G2 packet, G1 source contracts, write-a-skill goodness criteria and lean archetype. Verify the handoff is complete and classify replan; attest c1.

postconditions.statement: all context and contracts loaded; handoff complete; replan classified as lean

constraints: no lifecycle wiring or network writes

m1-contract-red.title: Encode the frozen replan contract tests
m1-contract-red.imperative: Create tests/test_replan.py first for exact schemas, four exits, dispositions, preservation/escalation, rendering, and offline behavior; run the identical focused command and capture a causal RED on missing replanning behavior.

preconditions.statement: context loaded and lean classification complete

postconditions.statement: tests were written before production changes and identical focused command exited 1 on missing replanning behavior

m2-replan-green.title: Mint strict lean replan behavior
m2-replan-green.imperative: Scaffold from the lean archetype and minimally implement strict v1 input/result templates plus pure verifier/renderer covering all four exits, identity/disposition completeness, preservation, typed escalation, and offline Markdown.
constraints: fixed fields require inapplicable typed escalation

m3-register-goodness.title: Register and audit semantic goodness
m3-register-goodness.imperative: Register script/reference bundles and live index, update installer/write-a-skill tests, clear verify_skill_registered, inspect the lean skill against shared goodness and run public-helper wiring grep.

postconditions.statement: skill goodness, negative space, completion criteria, and public helper wiring audited

constraints: fresh independent semantic review remains G2 reviewer responsibility

m4-closeout.title: Verify and return Gate 2
m4-closeout.imperative: Run the identical final focused command, compute ordinal path+byte digest after final test/edit, inspect scope/exclusions, write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT with required evidence and workflow feedback, advance, then release.

preconditions.statement: implementation, registration, goodness, and wiring checks complete
preconditions.satisfied_by: Implementation, registration rail, semantic goodness, helper wiring, and offline scope checks are complete.

check.command: uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_replan.py tests/test_install_constellation.py tests/test_write_a_skill.py

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT contains gate identity, causal red/green, ordinal digest/inventory, scope, map impact, and workflow feedback
postconditions.satisfied_by: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT records gate identity, tests-first causal RED and identical GREEN, exact ordinal path+byte digest inventory/helper, scope and exclusions, map impact, and workflow feedback.

payload.cmd: uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_replan.py tests/test_install_constellation.py tests/test_write_a_skill.py

why_trail.why: Replan is a lean judgment-to-contract skill: the agent authors the four-way wave decision while pure code validates exact G1 nesting, disposition completeness, launched stability, and typed human escalation without ordered engine state.

The identical focused command exits 1 with explicit missing-replanning-behavior failures for the strict verifier/templates, mint registration, and installability; 13 behavior tests skip rather than failing on import or path setup.

The lean skill now verifies exact G1-nested packets, one-to-one classified and unlaunched dispositions, all four exits, repair holds, launched stability, five typed fixed-boundary escalations, and renders an offline transition record.

The minted skill follows the lean archetype with action-leading steps, explicit completion and negative space, a single invariant rail, and independent semantic review handoff; every public verifier/renderer/CLI helper has executable call sites and no network-capable imports.

The exact frozen suite passes 133 tests and 407 subtests; the final 11-path review identity is sha256:bcac2c18ac5a6d88883f6123d173b72d4f020fd457b42b4b04268674a481abd5, scope remains within G2, and the local implementer result preserves causal TDD and workflow evidence for fresh review.
